plan.notes: Molecular and Cellular Biology concentration. Built directly from the official 2026-2027 University Catalog PDF 'Molecular and Cellular Biology Concentration' semester-by-semester roadmap, cross-checked against the Major Requirements table. Slots modeled as student-choice: General Chemistry Elective (4 cr; CHEM 10058&10059 or CHEM 10060&10061), Organic Chemistry I (CHEM 20481 or CHEM 30481), Organic Chemistry II (CHEM 20482 or CHEM 30475 or CHEM 30482; the official grid shows this slot in both Semesters 3 and 4 at 0-4 credits -- modeled as completed in Semester 3 at 4 credits, the recommended path), Quantitative Methods elective (BSCI 40224, MATH 12003, or MATH 30011; modeled at 3 credits), Biology Electives and/or Biology, Chemistry, Physics (BCP) Electives (total 31 credits combined across the plan, e.g., PHY 13001/13002 with labs, additional BSCI courses chosen with advisor). Foreign Language 8 credits (College of Sciences and Humanities B.S. requirement). Prerequisite chain follows the natural course sequence: BSCI 10110 -> BSCI 10120 -> BSCI 30140 -> BSCI 40158; CHEM 10062 -> CHEM 10063; General Chemistry -> Organic Chemistry I -> Organic Chemistry II; BSCI 30156 -> BSCI 40163.
